verdict.rationale: Alloy's own docs say manual reviews occur on its automated decisions and fire webhook events (alloy-docs-5), which implies a human can inspect and act on an automated outcome. Evaluation results and warnings are returned in the API and dashboard (alloy-docs-4, alloy-docs-11), and Alloy markets its agentic automation as 'fully auditable' (alloy-docs-20). Missing for 10: documented ability to override an automated decision, explicit preservation of the original evidence and rationale after an override, an audit trail of override history, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
